study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: Placental location over a uterine scar
Ultrasound markers (loss of clear zone, placental lacunae, placental bulge, bridging vessels)
cohort: The study included 315 women with suspected Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) from 23 international expert centers, with 182 participants included in the final analysis after exclusions.
finding: Antenatal bleeding and placental location away from the uterine scar were identified as the most significant independent predictive factors for emergent delivery among patients with PAS.
mod_finding: The study compared outcomes between emergent and scheduled deliveries, finding no significant differences in maternal outcomes between groups delivered in expert centers.
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery (34.7 weeks in scheduled group vs. 32.9 weeks in emergent group)
